alerts.title: Carbamazepine Toxicity
alerts.message: Guidelines warn of carbamazepine decreasing DTG levels. Patient shows symptoms of carbamazepine toxicity with a level of 14 mcg/mL, above the therapeutic range. This could be due to the drug itself, but other causes like seizures or interactions should be considered.

evidence.recommended_action: Monitor DTG levels and adjust carbamazepine dose
